title: Patriots receiver makes outrageous social media post

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Patriots receiver makes outrageous social media post
sources.description: Just minutes after the Patriots wrapped up their second day of OTAs on Wednesday afternoon, second-year wide receiver Kyle Williams took to social media to voice his early frustrations. “Ain’t no way OTA’s feeling like training camp,” Williams captioned on an Instagram Story photo, sitting at his locker. The Patriots’ offseason has been a distracting one, as coach Mike Vrabel has been in the spotlight for cheating on his wife with NFL insider Dianna Russini, and rumors have circled around the team regarding a trade for Eagles wide receiver A.J. Brown.
